base_candidate.role: frozen Nautilus detector substrate, external pools, execution, costs, portfolio mutex and current-NAV risk path

project_learning_source.use: Candidate 15 independently integrates and validates the persistent-initiative mechanism; Candidate 13 code or claims are not treated as evidence of profitability.

research_question: Can repeated cross-market common-flow events identify a persistent information state whose later independent five-minute auction legs remain tradable after realistic costs?

hypothesis.state_observation: At each UTC quarter-hour, inspect the first completed five-minute interval. A common-flow event requires at least three of BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP to exhibit the same directional body, inherited displacement magnitude and same-signed taker-flow proxy.
hypothesis.activation: The first event is only a candidate. A second distinct same-direction event within four hours activates persistent initiative. An opposite event invalidates the candidate and terminates an opposite active state.
hypothesis.state_invalidation: Terminate on four-hour information expiry or when a majority of accepted markets closes back through the latest confirming impulse origins at a completed five-minute boundary.
hypothesis.entry_scenario: The periodic event is never traded. After activation, each market independently requires a fresh five-minute structure break, directional displacement, strict three-candle FVG and passive first consequent-encroachment retracement.
hypothesis.stop: Beyond the last opposing five-minute bar or causally protected swing plus inherited ATR buffer.
hypothesis.target: Next causally confirmed live external completed-4H or previous-UTC-day pool in the initiative direction.
hypothesis.independence: One plan per distinct post-activation five-minute displacement identity; all markets compete through the unchanged global one-slot mutex.
hypothesis.family_isolation: V1-V3 SCDAM plans and SESSION_I7 are observed but explicitly rejected. V4 development measures only the independent persistent-initiative family.
hypothesis.execution_safety: A rejected protective child after a parent fill cancels remaining orders and immediately flattens residual exposure while preserving an engine-error failure record.

selection.method: E01-E06 are deliberately reused exposed diagnostic weeks already named by a parallel project branch. They span adverse, strong, high-frequency, mid-regime and recent conditions and can only reject or improve the mechanism; they can never support a success claim.

research_basis.source: Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov, The Price Impact of Order Book Events, arXiv:1011.6402
research_basis.use: directional taker-flow agreement is treated as a state observation rather than an entry by itself
cross-market flow effects are short-lived and state dependent, motivating explicit activation and expiry
leadership is allowed to change; the state requires breadth and does not permanently privilege BTC or any altcoin

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and cannot support a success claim.
Passing the development gate only permits a source freeze and newly predeclared confirmation screen.
A final success claim additionally requires a frozen continuous-account evaluation with realistic costs and no liquidation or unrecoverable account damage.
